title: 第9章 入学埃利斯学院第10章 第一堂课
content_zh:
在格林城转悠几天，亲眼见识了这个不同的世界，与几个狐朋狗友正式告别。
在胖子山姆的特意安排下，期间又见到了把他灌倒的安琪，在一对一单喝的情况下，他再次被安琪给灌倒。
对此，默里·格林悲愤的表示，是这具身体才成年，以前很少喝酒，等他从学校回来，就会让安琪好看。
过后，他就跟着莱茵·格林，在骑兵小队的护送下，没有出一点意外的赶到埃利斯城，在埃利斯学院报名，成功入学。
“默里.格林，这是你的学生卡，宿舍钥匙，基础课程表，请你收好，在学校中，许多事都需要学生卡。”
“如果丢失，请第一时间来教务处补办，十个金币一次，如有其他疑问，可以在前台咨询服务人员，请下一位同学来缴费。”
默里·格林接过一张灰色的卡片，“埃利斯学院”五个字映入眼帘，往下，是“魔法分院”，接着就是他的名字“默里.格林”。
最后为“神启历四千二百五十五年三月一日”这个入学时间，卡片背后是他的魔法留影。
埃利斯学院，北地第一学院，是北地掌控者，北地大公爵埃利斯家族建立的学院。
已经建校五百多年，专门培养战士和魔法师，基本上整个北地的贵族，有条件的都会把自己子女送到这个学院里学习。
在这里，不仅能够学到系统性的知识，还能拓宽自己的人脉，莱茵.格林除了在伯爵手下接受培训外，也在埃利斯学院的战士分院中学习。
把这张价值十个金币的学生卡小心收好之后，默里转头看向一旁的莱茵.格林。
“魔法学院住宿楼在哪里？”
相比起默里这个入学新生，开学后，莱茵现在已经是一个三年级的老生，学习生涯已经过半。
“魔法学院，我去过几次，跟我来吧！”
埃利斯学院很大，占地近万亩，比上个世界许多大学都大。
但是埃利斯学院的正式学生却只有五千多人，加上教职工侍卫佣人也不超过一万人，可以说是地广人稀。
而默里.格林即将进入的魔法分院，四个年级加起来不超过一千人，却占据了埃利斯学院三分之一的地盘。
所以就算是入学日，魔法学院的行人都不算多，很少有人出来闲逛。
跟随大哥莱茵走进魔法分院，映入眼帘的就是上百座高耸的魔法塔，这些魔法塔高低不一，但是最矮的也有五十米，最高的几百米。

经历过上个世界的网络洗礼，默里.格林可以说见识过现代世界许多高楼大厦，但是没想到第一次实地见到几百米的高塔，居然在这个看起来非常落后、只会码石头的世界。
站在几百米的高塔之下，默里的第一反应就是渺小。
在高塔之下，自己居然如此渺小。
“卧了个槽，这塔这么高？”
“斯坦利·埃利斯之塔，五百年前，埃利斯大公与大魔导师斯坦利·埃利斯共同建造二十年才完成。”
“斯坦利·埃利斯之塔建立之日，也是埃利斯学院成立之日，由大魔导师斯坦利·埃利斯担任第一任埃利斯学院院长。”
客串讲解员莱英.格林又开始稳定发挥，一路走，一路讲解，很快就来到一个三层建筑面前。
相对于高耸的魔法塔，这栋三层建筑高度不过四十米，但是建筑面积极为庞大。
这就是魔法分院的教学楼。
“到了。”
路过教学楼，默里.格林看到五栋五层建筑，这就是魔法住宿楼，而默里还看到这五栋住宿楼周围，有许多独栋小城堡。
content_en:
After wandering around Green City for a few days, I saw this different world with my own eyes and officially said goodbye to a few of my friends.
Under the special arrangement of Fatty Sam, he met Angel again who had drunk him down. While drinking alone, he was drunk again by Angel.
In response to this, Murray Green said sadly and angrily that this body was just an adult and he rarely drank alcohol before. When he comes back from school, he will make Angel look good.
After that, he followed Rhine Green, and under the escort of the cavalry squad, he rushed to Ellis City without any accidents, registered at Ellis College, and successfully enrolled.
"Murray Green, here is your student card, dormitory key, and basic course schedule. Please keep it. In school, many things require a student card."
"If you lose it, please come to the Academic Affairs Office to get a replacement as soon as possible. Ten gold coins per time. If you have any other questions, you can consult the service staff at the front desk and ask the next student to pay."
Murray Green took a gray card, and the words "Ellis College" came into view, followed by "Magic Branch", and then his name "Murray Green".
Finally, it is the enrollment time of "March 1, 4255th Year of the Divine Enlightenment". Behind the card is his magical photo.
Ellis College, the first college in the North, is a college established by the Ellis family, the rulers of the North and the Grand Duke of the North.
The school has been established for more than five hundred years and specializes in training warriors and magicians. Basically, all the nobles in the North will send their children to study in this academy if they can.
Here, not only can you learn systematic knowledge, but you can also broaden your network. In addition to receiving training under the Count, Rhine Green also studied in the Warrior Branch of Ellis Academy.
After carefully putting away the student card worth ten gold coins, Murray turned to look at Rhine Green.
"Where is the dormitory building of the Magic Academy?"
Compared with Murray, a freshman, after the start of school, Laing is now a third-year veteran and is halfway through his academic career.
"I've been to the Magic Academy several times, come with me!"
Ellis College is very large, covering an area of nearly 10,000 acres, larger than many universities in the previous world.
However, there are only more than 5,000 formal students in Ellis College, and the number of faculty, staff, guards and servants does not exceed 10,000. It can be said that the land is vast and sparsely populated.
The Magic Branch that Murray Green is about to enter has no more than a thousand students in the four grades, but it occupies one-third of Ellis College.
Therefore, even on the entrance day, there are not many pedestrians in the Magic Academy, and few people hang out.
When I followed my eldest brother Rhine into the magic branch, I saw hundreds of towering magic towers. These magic towers vary in height, but the shortest one is fifty meters and the highest one is several hundred meters.
Having experienced the baptism of the Internet in the previous world, Murray Green can be said to have seen many high-rise buildings in the modern world, but he did not expect to see a tower of several hundred meters tall for the first time in this seemingly very backward world where he only knows how to stack stones.
Standing under a tower several hundred meters high, Murray's first reaction was one of insignificance.
Under the tower, I was so small.
"What the hell, is this tower so high?"
"The Tower of Stanley Ellis was built five hundred years ago by Grand Duke Ellis and Grand Magister Stanley Ellis and took 20 years to complete."
"The day Stanley Ellis Tower was established was also the day Ellis College was founded. Grand Magister Stanley Ellis served as the first president of Ellis College."
Guest commentator Laing Green began to perform steadily again, walking and explaining all the way, and soon came to a three-story building.
Compared to the towering Magic Tower, this three-story building is only forty meters high, but its building area is extremely large.
This is the teaching building of the Magic Branch.
"Arrived."
Passing by the teaching building, Murray Green looked atWe arrived at five five-story buildings, which were the magic accommodation buildings, and Murray also saw many small independent castles surrounding these five accommodation buildings.
